keyEvents.text: Goal! Colorado Rapids 1, Chicago Fire FC 0. Morgan Whittaker (Colorado Rapids) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Georgi Minoungou.
Goal! Colorado Rapids 1, Chicago Fire FC 1. Jonathan Bamba (Chicago Fire FC) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Noah Allen (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Colorado Rapids 1, Chicago Fire FC 1.
Miguel Navarro (Colorado Rapids) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Colorado Rapids 1, Chicago Fire FC 2. Jonathan Bamba (Chicago Fire FC) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jonathan Dean with a cross.

Goal! Colorado Rapids 2, Chicago Fire FC 2. Paxten Aaronson (Colorado Rapids) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Georgi Minoungou with a cross.
Substitution, Colorado Rapids. Noah Cobb replaces Keegan Rosenberry.
Substitution, Colorado Rapids. Donavan Phillip replaces Darren Yapi.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Anzor Mekvabishvili replaces Djé D'Avilla.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Robert Lewandowski replaces Maren Haile-Selassie.
Delay in match because of an injury Georgi Minoungou (Colorado Rapids).
Substitution, Colorado Rapids. Ted Ku-DiPietro replaces Georgi Minoungou because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Hamzat Ojediran (Colorado Rapids) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ted Ku-DiPietro (Colorado Rapids) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Colorado Rapids 2, Chicago Fire FC 3. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Philip Zinckernagel.
Substitution, Colorado Rapids. Sayed Abu Farhi replaces Hamzat Ojediran.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. André Franco replaces Johan Gómez.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Andrew Gutman replaces Noah Allen.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Puso Dithejane replaces Philip Zinckernagel.

Goal! Colorado Rapids 2, Chicago Fire FC 4. Puso Dithejane (Chicago Fire FC) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Robert Lewandowski with a through ball.
Rob Holding (Colorado Rapids) is shown the yellow card.
Andrew Gutman (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Colorado Rapids 2, Chicago Fire FC 4.
